title: License Reassignment
text: A license may be reassigned to another employee after 90 days. Exceptions require administrator approval.

title: Seat Allocation
text: Customers may allocate seats only up to the number of active licenses they own.

title: Inactive Licenses
text: Inactive licenses cannot be used to provision new users or services.

title: License Renewal
text: Annual subscriptions must be renewed before their expiration date to avoid service interruption.

title: Customer Eligibility
text: A customer account must be active and verified before new licenses can be assigned.

title: Power BI Access
text: Power BI Pro users require an assigned active license to access Pro-only collaboration features.

title: Microsoft 365 Seat Changes
text: Requests to purchase additional Microsoft 365 seats must be submitted through the authorized purchasing workflow.

title: License Audit
text: License assignment and reassignment events must be recorded for audit and compliance review.

title: Regional Restrictions
text: Certain licensing offers are available only in eligible geographic regions.

title: Subscription Cancellation
text: Cancellation requests must follow the applicable subscription agreement and billing terms.

title: License Transfer
text: License transfers between accounts require approval from the account administrator and may be subject to additional fees.

title: Trial License Limitations
text: Trial licenses are limited to a single use per customer and cannot be extended or renewed.

title: License Expiration Notifications
text: Customers will receive notifications regarding license expiration at least 30 days prior to the expiration date.

title: License Compliance
text: Customers must ensure that their use of licenses complies with the terms of the licensing agreement.

title: License Upgrade Path
text: Customers may upgrade their licenses to higher tiers, subject to availability and pricing.
